newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul court issues warrant for president's son.
newsitem.headline: Seoul court issues warrant for president's son.

text.p: A South Korean court issued an arrest warrant on Saturday for President Kim Young-sam's son, Kim Hyun-chul, on charges of bribery and tax evasion, a court official said.
"The arrest warrant for Kim Hyun-chul has just been issued," the court official said.
State prosecutors had sought the warrant against the junior Kim for accepting kickbacks worth 3.2 billion won ($3.6 million) in return for favours. Kim Hyun-chul has denied accepting bribes.
Kim Hyun-chul also would be charged with evading taxes on 3.3 billion won given to him by businessmen, but not as bribes, prosecutors earlier said.

An arrest is widely expected later on Saturday, bringing to a climax a corruption scandal involving top politicians, bankers and businessmen that emerged from the collapse in January of Hanbo Steel Co.
